chrome.title: Myriad - A myriad of lights, in one place.
chrome.description: Myriad is a self-hosted personal digital-life homepage for aggregating, organizing, and presenting data from multiple platforms.
chrome.noscript: Enable JavaScript to load the full interactive homepage.

tour.hintBody: Explains the main controls on this page.
tour.couldNotStart: No tour targets were found on this page

nav.title: Navigation
nav.body: Switch among Home, Library, Brew Reader, Platform Reports, and Tapp Apps.

home-grid.title: Widget grid
home-grid.body: The widget board shown first when the site opens.

home-agent.title: Agent
home-agent.body: Long-press any empty area to open it. Buttons, links, and navigation do not trigger it. Continues after it opens.

home-agent-panel.title: Agent
home-agent-panel.body: Type and send here. Click outside the panel to dismiss it.

home-edit.title: Edit
home-edit.body: Enter edit mode to change the layout and add or remove widgets.

home-edit-grid.title: Tiles
home-edit-grid.body: Drag to move or resize. Long-press opens settings. Delete from the corner.

home-widget-library.title: Widget library
home-widget-library.body: Drag a widget onto the grid to add it.

home-free-layout.title: Free layout
home-free-layout.body: Switch between standard and free layout. Cell size is the same. The free canvas is 16×8; each layout stores its own positions.

home-sticker.title: Stickers
home-sticker.body: Pick an empty slot, then generate or upload. They do not count toward the widget cell budget.

control-island.title: Control island
control-island.body: Collapsed, it cycles site info. Open it to expand the control panel.

control-island-owner.title: Control island
control-island-owner.body: Collapsed, it cycles site info. Open it to expand the control panel.

control-panel.title: Control panel
control-panel.body: Appearance, Animation, and language. Sign in here. Play music on this site. Switch between Controls and Notifications.

control-panel-owner.title: Control panel
control-panel-owner.body: Appearance, Animation, and language. Open system config. Play music on this site. Switch between Controls and Notifications.

library-filters.title: Filters
library-filters.body: Filter by All, Games, Videos, Music, Anime, TV Series, or Books. If collapsed, open Library again.

library-grid.title: Collection
library-grid.body: Synced items. Scroll down to load more.

library-grid-canvas.title: Collection
library-grid-canvas.body: Synced items spread out from the center. Drag to pan the canvas.

library-card.title: Card
library-card.body: Open a card to go to the source site. NetEase plays on this site. Corners show the source and rating.

library-canvas.title: Canvas
library-canvas.body: Zoom the infinite canvas, or reset to center.

reports-status.title: Status bar
reports-status.body: Cycles through platform and playback status on this page.

reports-cards.title: Platform cards
reports-cards.body: One card per platform. Open an existing report.

reports-cards-owner.title: Platform cards
reports-cards-owner.body: One card per platform. Open an existing report, or generate one here.

tapp-store-entry.title: Store
tapp-store-entry.body: Open the store to browse and install apps.

tapp-scope.title: Scope
tapp-scope.body: Switch between My apps and Site apps.

tapp-open-playground.title: Playground
tapp-open-playground.body: Generate an app from natural language. Runs in a temporary sandbox with no granted permissions.

tapp-grid.title: Installed apps
tapp-grid.body: Open a card to run the app.

tapp-grid-owner.title: Installed apps
tapp-grid-owner.body: Open a card to run it. Start, stop, open settings, or uninstall. Reorder and resize cards here.

config-search.title: Search
config-search.body: Find settings by name or guide text.

config-ai-persona-toggle.title: Persona
config-ai-persona-toggle.body: When on, Agent speaks with this persona. Writing it needs Pro.

config-ai-persona-card.title: Character
config-ai-persona-card.body: Start setup if empty. Open character settings or delete when one exists.

config-ai-persona-speech.title: Speak
config-ai-persona-speech.body: Read chat replies aloud. Unavailable while the persona is off.

config-persona-tabs.title: Tabs
config-persona-tabs.body: Switch among Overview, Persona, Wardrobe, and Motion.

config-persona-portrait.title: Portrait
config-persona-portrait.body: Current face preview. Plays here once a rig exists.

config-persona-overview.title: Overview
config-persona-overview.body: Name, mood and activity, sticker avatar, and Do not disturb.

config-persona-identity.title: Persona
config-persona-identity.body: Temperament, likes, drives, social style, and speech. Import or edit each field. Owner-only write.

config-persona-wardrobe.title: Wardrobe
config-persona-wardrobe.body: Open a set to manage its portrait. Face and hair stay fixed. New outfits can be added.

config-persona-motion.title: Motion
config-persona-motion.body: Preview and adjust motion after a rig is imported.

tapp-detail-overview.title: Overview
tapp-detail-overview.body: App info. Export is available. Start, stop, or uninstall when you have permission.

tapp-detail-settings.title: App settings
tapp-detail-settings.body: This installation’s config. Visible when signed in. Visibility is owner-only.

tapp-detail-permissions.title: Permissions
tapp-detail-permissions.body: Read-only list of granted permissions for this installation.

tapp-playground-toolbar.title: Toolbar
tapp-playground-toolbar.body: Return to the app list. This sandbox has no granted permissions.

tapp-playground-preview.title: Page preview
tapp-playground-preview.body: Placeholder until something is generated. After generation it runs in the temporary sandbox.

tapp-playground-code.title: Code
tapp-playground-code.body: Generated source. Switch files and edit them. Compare versions when more than one exists.

tapp-playground-prompt.title: Prompt
tapp-playground-prompt.body: Describe what to generate or change in natural language. Empty sessions can fill from examples. Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts a line break.

tapp-playground-generate.title: Generate
tapp-playground-generate.body: Submit to generate or apply changes, then run in the temporary sandbox.

tapp-playground-history.title: History
tapp-playground-history.body: Session change history. Switch, create, or delete sessions.

tapp-playground-install.title: Install
tapp-playground-install.body: Install on this site. Granted permissions exist only after install.

setup.title: System Setup
setup.welcomeDesc: Bring the data scattered across your platforms into one place that is truly yours. Connect PostgreSQL and create an owner account to get started.
setup.welcomeReady: Start exploring when setup is done
setup.welcomeFootnote: Setup usually takes only a few minutes
